reason: I'm not handing real money to an app with zero reviews and no name I recognize behind it, and the broker part is just 'planned' with a partner nobody has named. My broker already throws AI tools in for free and my robo-adviser already does the hands-off part, so a waitlist for a paid plan with no price doesn't get me to sign up.
objection: No track record, no reviews and no known licensed broker named. If an unknown startup's agent makes a bad trade or the company folds, I don't know who's on the hook for my money.
would_change_my_mind: A named, well-known licensed broker holding the money, plus a solid stack of real user reviews after the real-money version has been running a while.
